prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A cinematic, low-angle shot of a basketball player captured in dramatic silhouette against a pale blue sky. The subject stands confidently, holding a basketball at their side with one hand, their arm relaxed but ready, while the other arm hangs loosely. The figure is dressed in athletic shorts and a sleeveless top, the contours of their clothing and body defined by the strong backlighting. The lighting is soft yet striking, creating a high-contrast effect that emphasizes the outline of the player and the round shape of the basketball. The background is minimal and uncluttered, consisting solely of a smooth gradient sky, which enhances the sense of focus and anticipation. The overall mood is contemplative and powerful, evoking themes of determination and solitude. The composition uses shallow depth of field to keep the subject crisp while the background remains smooth and abstract, lending the image a modern, almost painterly quality.
